notes: Source-wide method; final numeric shell thickness and exact specimen dosing are unreported. Main first-layer emission observation is not silently equated to the terminal five-layer series.

quality.review_scope: All seven main and ten supporting-information pages read as text and actual page images. Source alternatives, sample-specific observations, common procedures and authors’ interpretations are distinguished. Unreported details remain missing; no plot digitization or measured atomistic heterostructure is claimed.
missing_fields: Exact physical batch identifiers and atomistic specimen coordinates are not reported.

Seed sediment mass, per-stock injection amounts/order/rates/intervals, aliquot schedule, flask geometry, measured shell thickness, washing-solvent quantities, sonication power, phase composition, centrifugation settings, yield and storage.
conflicts: Main p.3 describes strong visible emission after only one atomic CdS layer; SI p.3 first injection represents two atomic layers and proceeds through the fifth layer, while describing visible onset after the first shell. These are retained as separate process/observation statements, not silently converted into a measured final layer count.
